summary: Master the art of designing Executive Dashboards for business leaders. Join our training course to enhance your data visualization and decision-making skills.
lede: Designing Executive Dashboards for Business Leaders equips professionals to create clear, credible dashboards that help executives understand performance and make informed decisions. Rather than adding more charts, the course focuses on selecting meaningful KPIs, connecting measures to strategy, and presenting the right information at the right level and time. Participants learn to identify leadership needs, reduce cognitive load through effective layouts, and use visual storytelling to clarify what is happening, why it is happening, and what to do next. Practical guidance on metric governance and dashboard rollout helps turn reporting into a leadership communication skill that surfaces risk and guides action.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who design, manage, interpret, or present dashboards for leaders.
modules: Understanding Executive Stakeholders and Their Questions
KPI Selection That Aligns to Strategy
Dashboarding for Public Sector and NGO Performance
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of data and metrics, as well as experience in reporting or analytics roles. Familiarity with basic dashboard tools (Excel, Power BI, Tableau) is beneficial but not required.
